steps.text: Click the row of the meter you want to edit to open its detail page.

steps.text: Tap the card of the meter you want to edit to open its detail page.
steps.title: Open the meter detail

steps.text: The detail page shows the meter's current information: EAN, installation address and technical characteristics.
steps.title: Initial detail

steps.text: Click "Modify" to open the dialog containing the meter's editable fields (address, number, EAN and characteristics).
steps.title: Open the edit form

steps.text: Edit the fields you want to change — here the installation address and the meter's physical number. The EAN and technical characteristics stay the same.
